canonical_bytes: UTF-8 canonical JSON with recursively Unicode-code-point-sorted object keys, arrays preserved, no spaces, trailing LF, ensure_ascii=false, allow_nan=false

gap_atom_mapping.atom_id_rule: canonical atom id is <projection_key>::<dimension>::<frozen_required_atom>; the required atom name must come from task5-quality-cases-v2.json for that exact projection and dimension
gap_atom_mapping.gap_atom_refs_rule: quality_result.gap_atom_refs must equal CompanyBrainObservation.gap_atom_mapping.atom_ids, in frozen rubric order; implementation may not invent, rename or select atoms from prose

dimension_result.kd_observation_ref_rule: must resolve to the same KnowledgeDigest Reader page_path#unit_id or page_path#surface for this projection and dimension; an Audit-only ref is invalid

atom_observation_contract.binding_rule: one item per frozen required atom; applicable is copied from the rubric; unknown never passes

advantage_basis.strict_advantage_rule: gap_atom_refs must be a subset of applicable atoms whose CompanyBrain status is absent and whose observation maps to cb_gap_locator; semantic stage gaps are recorded in gap_stage_refs and may prove a win when the frozen atom rubric has no corresponding literal gap; strict_improvement_refs must be non-empty and each must be cb absent plus kd present; non_regression is true only when no applicable atom or stage regresses and no status is unknown or forbidden; KD_WIN requires these checks plus all existing hard gates

semantic_stage_observation_contract.binding_rule: one item per frozen semantic stage for the same projection and dimension; stage definitions come from task5-quality-cases.v2 semantic_contracts; unknown never passes

quality_feature_observation_contract.relation_rule: feature scores compare the same evidence-backed feature on both Reader surfaces; blocking regression or unknown prevents a strict win, and at least one strict feature or stage improvement is required
quality_feature_observation_contract.binding_rule: feature definitions and weights come only from task5-quality-cases-v2 semantic_contracts.quality_features; labels alone never create a feature improvement

advantage_basis.binding_rule: exactly one basis per applicable projection_key x dimension; no basis may be reused across dimensions
